behaviors.description: Run an app that consumes piped stdin and writes to the controlling terminal.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of the fixture app and an interactive pseudo-terminal shell.
behaviors.expected: The app receives and echoes the exact piped marker, exits zero, and is not suspended for terminal output.

mappings.rationale: An installed fixture app consumes a real pipe and writes the exact marker to a controlling pseudo-terminal through the public run command.
